Traduzir grandes volumes de informação em decisões de negócio efetivas;

Definir e supervisionar a estratégia de migração de dados de sistemas legados para novas soluções.

Requisitos: Forte conhecimento em arquitetura e modelagem de dados para ambientes analíticos.o Experiência na definição e evolução de arquiteturas Data Lake, Data Lakehouse e plataformas analíticas corporativas.o Capacidade de desenhar soluções escaláveis para ingestão, processamento, armazenamento e consumo de dados.o Conhecimento de modelagem dimensional, Data Vault e estratégias de integração de dados.o Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento de dados em tempo real.o Vivência com governança, qualidade, segurança, linhagem e observabilidade de dados.o Experiência em ambientes AWS, incluindo definição de arquiteturas, segurança e gestão de acessos.o Capacidade de avaliar trade-offs técnicos, custos, escalabilidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

  • Plataforma e Ferramentaso Conhecimento sólido em: Kafka para arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, streaming e integrações assíncronas. Databricks para implementação de arquiteturas Lakehouse, engenharia e analytics. Apache Airflow para definição e orquestração de fluxos de dados. Spark/PySpark para processamento distribuído e otimização de workloads. Arquitetura medalhão e data mesh.o Experiência em AWS, incluindo S3, Glue, IAM, Lambda, Athena, EMR e demais serviços relacionados a dados e analytics.
  • Arquitetura de Integração e Plataformao Experiência no desenho de integrações entre sistemas transacionais, plataformas analíticas e consumidores de dados.o Conhecimento de APIs, mensageria e padrões de integração corporativa.o Definição de padrões arquiteturais, frameworks e boas práticas para a plataforma de dados. Atividades previstas:o Definir e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis.o Projetar a arquitetura de dados (batch e streaming) considerando o contexto de migração de sistemas de conciliação financeira.o Estruturar ambientes em AWS, incluindo configuração de clusters e gestão de acessos (IAM).o Garantir ingestão, transformação e disponibilização eficiente de dados (ETL/ELT) para alto volume transacional.o Atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio financeiro e times técnicos, garantindo consistência e viabilidade das soluções.o Apoiar a migração de dados entre sistemas legados e a nova plataforma, assegurando integridade e rastreabilidade

_Soft Skills (Comportamentais)

  • Liderança Técnica: Capacidade de orientar e desenvolver tecnicamente o timeo Atuação hands-on quando necessário, sendo referência técnica
  • Visão de Negócio Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Avaliar impactos técnicos, custos e benefícios das decisões arquiteturais

  • Comunicação Comunicação clara e assertiva com times técnicos e não técnicos. Facilidade para dialogar com stakeholders, fornecedores e áreas de negócio
  • Metodologias Ágeis Vivência prática em modelos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou híbridos) Participação ativa em cerimônias, planejamento e priorização técnica
  • Postura Colaborativa Desprendimento e flexibilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos Espírito de dono, senso de responsabilidade e foco em resultados Abertura para aprendizado contínuo e troca de conhecimento
  • Importante: Será considerada um diferencial a experiência em ambientes regulados ou de alta criticidade e volume transacional, especialmente em contextos que envolvam conciliação, auditoria, controles financeiros, qualidade e rastreabilidade.

Localidade da posição: Remoto

Quem é a Insi?

Somos uma consultoria especializada em evolução digital. Mas, acima de tudo, somos uma empresa de gente. Gente que ouve antes de propor. Que vai ao essencial antes de apresentar solução. Que mede sucesso pelo que mudou de verdade, não pelo que foi implementado.

Com mais de três décadas de história e presença global, acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação começa dentro: dentro das pessoas, das equipes, das organizações — e é essa convicção que orienta cada escolha que fazemos, cada projeto que entregamos, cada pessoa que desenvolvemos.

Por que construir sua carreira na Insi?

Porque aqui você pensa, decide e cria junto. Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente onde os Insiders têm espaço para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de projetos desafiadores, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo.

Somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e estamos entre os 10 melhores empregadores do Brasil segundo a revista TIME.

Quais são nossos valores?

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Atuamos com criatividade e inovação

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerInsi!

title: Senior Video and Motion Designer
description:

This person will play an important role in shaping the visual quality of our products, creating assets, animations, and experiences with the level of polish needed to differentiate our games in a highly competitive market.

Responsibilities

  • Create motion graphics, animations, and video content for games, campaigns, promotions, and products
  • Develop visual assets for multiple proprietary games
  • Create static and animated layouts for different channels, formats, and platforms
  • Animate typography, logos, characters, icons, interfaces, and other graphic elements
  • Develop key visuals and their adaptations across different formats
  • Ensure a high level of quality, consistency, and polish across all visual assets
  • Actively contribute to the visual evolution of our games and brand language
  • Propose creative and visual solutions with a high degree of autonomy
  • Adapt materials across different formats, aspect ratios, markets, and platforms
  • Explore new visual languages, trends, and references relevant to the gaming and entertainment industries
  • Collaborate closely with Design, Marketing, Product, and Content teams

Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in Design and Motion Design
  • Advanced proficiency in After Effects
  • Strong knowledge of graphic design, composition, typography, and visual direction
  • Experience with motion graphics, animation, and video content production
  • Strong proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Ability to develop highly polished visual assets
  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to independently lead projects and propose creative solutions
  • Ability to manage multiple formats and projects simultaneously
  • Strong sense of rhythm, timing, and transitions
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality work across design and motion

Nice to Have

  • Experience in iGaming, gaming, or entertainment
  • Experience creating assets for games
  • Knowledge of Figma
  • Experience with Blender, Cinema 4D, or other 3D tools
  • Experience with video editing and post-production
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to creative workflows

We are looking for a senior professional who is creative, organized, and collaborative, with a strong aesthetic sense, broad visual repertoire, and the ability to elevate the overall quality of our projects. Someone who can turn concepts into high-quality visual assets and experiences while directly contributing to making our proprietary games stand out in the iGaming market.

title: 销售部长
description:
工作职责:

1、统筹公司年度销售目标与销售策略制定,分解年度、季度及月度销售指标,确保整体业绩目标的达成与持续增长;

3、负责销售渠道的整体规划与管理,包括直营网点、经销商及重点客户,优化渠道结构,提升覆盖率与单店产出;

4、带领销售团队进行客户开发与关系维护,重点推进大客户及核心客户合作,提升客户转化率与长期价值;

5、结合市场与品牌策略,推动线索高效转化,与市场部门紧密协作,确保市场线索向实际订单和交付结果有效转化;

6、监控销售数据及业务表现,定期分析销售报表、成交结构与转化漏斗,及时调整销售策略并提出改进方案;

7、跟踪行业趋势与竞争对手销售策略,分析市场变化对销售的影响,制定具有竞争力的应对措施;

8、建立并领导高绩效销售团队,负责销售人员的招聘、培训、辅导与梯队建设,持续提升团队专业能力与稳定性;

9、对销售体系核心KPI全面负责,包括但不限于销售额、成交率、回款率、库存周转率及客户满意度等关键指标;

10、确保销售行为及流程符合当地法律法规及公司合规要求;

11、完成公司和上级领导安排的其他任务。

岗位要求:

1、本科及以上学历,市场营销、工商管理等相关专业,具备系统的销售管理与商业运营知识优先;

2、具备10年以上汽车行业相关经验,其中至少3年以上海外或国际市场销售管理经验,熟悉海外市场销售运作模式优先;

3、参与或主导过海外市场销售战略规划与落地执行,包括销售目标制定、渠道建设、产品导入及本地化销售推进优先;

4、具备在多文化、多语言环境下带领销售团队的经验,能够制定并执行海外销售策略,持续推动销量与市场份额增长优先;

5、具备较强的业务洞察力与数据分析能力,能基于销售数据

、市场反馈及竞争格局,快速调整销售策略与资源投入优先;

6、熟悉汽车行业销售流程与管理机制,包括线索转化、经销商管理、价格策略、促销政策及库存与交付协同优先;

7、能够高效协同公司内部市场、产品、售后及总部相关部门,整合资源支持海外市场与销售目标达成优先;

8、擅长与海外经销商、重点客户及合作伙伴建立长期合作关系,具备较强的商务谈判与客户关系管理能力优先;

9、具备优秀的团队管理与激励能力,能够搭建并管理高绩效销售团队,推动跨部门及跨区域协作优先;

10、CET6或以上,英语能作为工作语言,具备良好的跨文化交流能力优先;

11、能够接受海外出差或外派。

title: Estagiário de jornalismo
description:
O Diário de São José é um veículo digital independente que cobre São José dos Campos e o Vale do Paraíba, além de assuntos do Brasil e do mundo quando importam para o leitor daqui. Trabalhamos com apuração própria, linguagem direta e compromisso com o Código de Ética dos Jornalistas Brasileiros (FENAJ).

QUEM PODE SE CANDIDATAR

Estudantes de graduação em Jornalismo, de qualquer período.

Estudantes de curso técnico de nível médio em áreas da comunicação (comunicação visual, multimídia, design gráfico, produção audiovisual, publicidade e correlatos).

Estudantes dos anos finais do ensino médio com interesse em cursar Jornalismo.

Não é necessário ter experiência anterior em redação, portfólio publicado ou clipping. A vaga é de aprendizado real, com acompanhamento no dia a dia.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Acompanhar a agenda da cidade e sugerir pautas.

Apurar informações por telefone, e-mail e presencialmente.

Checar dados em fontes oficiais (Prefeitura, Câmara Municipal, governo estadual, órgãos federais, polícia, concessionárias).

Transcrever entrevistas e coletivas.

Ajudar na produção de conteúdo para redes sociais e na criação de artes simples.

Registrar imagens e vídeos curtos em coberturas de rua, quando necessário.

Aprender a estruturar texto e aplicar boas práticas de SEO.

Todo o trabalho é acompanhado e revisado por um jornalista responsável. Nada vai ao ar sem revisão.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI APRENDER

Apuração, checagem e confronto de versões.

Redação factual e uso correto de aspas, dados e fontes.

Ética jornalística aplicada ao dia a dia: presunção de inocência, direito de resposta, proteção de crianças e adolescentes e privacidade de pessoas não públicas.

Cobertura responsável de temas sensíveis, incluindo saúde mental e suicídio, conforme as diretrizes da OPAS/OMS e do CVV.

SEO, distribuição em redes sociais e leitura de métricas.

Uso de inteligência artificial como ferramenta de apoio à redação, dentro de critérios editoriais.

DIFERENCIAIS (NÃO ELIMINATÓRIOS)

Facilidade com redes sociais, especialmente Instagram, TikTok e WhatsApp.

Domínio de Canva ou de outra ferramenta de criação de artes.

Ser usuário frequente de ferramentas de inteligência artificial e ter curiosidade sobre como aplicá-las ao trabalho. No DSJ, IA é apoio operacional: não substitui apuração, não define pauta e todo conteúdo passa por checagem humana.

Saber gravar e editar vídeos curtos no celular.

Conhecer bem os bairros e a rotina da cidade.

PERFIL QUE PROCURAMOS

Curiosidade e vontade de entender como a cidade funciona.

Boa ortografia e disposição para escrever e reescrever.

Compromisso com prazo e com a exatidão da informação.

Discrição no trato com fontes e com informações não publicadas.

REQUISITOS FORMAIS

Matrícula ativa em instituição de ensino e possibilidade de assinatura do termo de compromisso de estágio.

Idade mínima de 16 anos.

Candidatos menores de 18 anos precisam de autorização do responsável legal, e a jornada será compatível com o horário escolar.

Envie sua pretensão de bolsa-auxílio na candidatura. É obrigatório.

Etapas: triagem das inscrições, conversa presencial ou on-line e um exercício prático simples de redação.

O Diário de São José recebe candidaturas de todas as pessoas que atendam aos requisitos formais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, origem ou deficiência.

Domínio em ferramentas do Microsoft 365 e canais de comunicação, como WhatsApp, Blip e Teams;

description:

description:
O Moreira Cruz Advogados é um escritório de advocacia consultiva empresarial, especializado em contratos e direito societário. title: Trainee Comercial | Mesa de Produtos (RF/RV)
description:
Sobre a Quark

Somos uma assessoria de investimentos credenciada pelo Banco Safra — a solidez de um banco com mais de 180 anos somada à agilidade de uma assessoria. Em poucos anos, passamos de R$1 bilhão sob custódia, com cerca de 70 assessores e mais de 3.000 clientes. Fomos eleitos Revelação Safra em 2024 e estamos entre os três melhores escritórios da rede.

Sobre a vaga

Esta é uma vaga de início de carreira, para quem tem perfil comercial e quer construir carreira no mercado financeiro. Você vai ser a ponte entre os nossos assessores e as áreas de produto da Quark: aprende a fundo os produtos — renda fixa, renda variável, seguros, consórcios — e ajuda os assessores a levá-los aos clientes deles.

É uma porta de entrada. Não é preciso ter experiência no mercado financeiro nem ser assessor credenciado — precisa ter tino comercial, vontade de aprender e energia para fazer negócio acontecer. No caminho, você conta com apoio para se certificar e crescer.

O que você vai fazer

  • Entender os produtos: dominar renda fixa, renda variável, seguros e consórcios para virar a referência de produto dos assessores.
  • Gerar oportunidades: trabalhar junto com os assessores, olhando as carteiras deles em busca de demandas de produto.
  • Apoiar a venda: apresentar as soluções de forma clara e conduzir cada oportunidade até o fechamento, com apoio no começo.
  • Cuidar do pipeline: controlar o funil no CRM, acompanhando cada oportunidade até a conversão.
  • Manter proximidade: conduzir os follow-ups e manter um canal aberto e constante com a rede de assessores.

O que buscamos em você

  • Perfil comercial: experiência com vendas, atendimento ou relacionamento com clientes — em qualquer setor, não precisa ser no mercado financeiro.
  • Vontade de aprender: interesse real pelo mercado financeiro e disposição para estudar os produtos e se certificar.
  • Comunicação clara e boa escuta.
  • Energia e disciplina para conduzir o pipeline e buscar resultado.
  • Formação: ensino superior completo ou em andamento.

O que oferecemos

  • Apoio para obter a certificação ANCORD.
  • Uma trilha para aprender os produtos e o funcionamento da mesa, com acompanhamento próximo.
  • Muito espaço para crescer conforme a sua evolução e os seus resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vendas de produtos ou serviços.
  • Boa desenvoltura com CRM.
  • Conhecimento inicial de produtos financeiros.

Se você quer entrar no mercado financeiro e tem energia para vender e aprender rápido, candidate-se por aqui. Vamos gostar de te conhecer.

description:
NÓS AJUDAMOS AS PESSOAS A ATINGIR SEUS OBJETIVOS NO MERCADO FINANCEIRO! TOPA VIR COM A GENTE?

Somos uma startup que une tecnologia e inovação em um mercado que não para de crescer!

title: Vendedor de sorvetes (diversas regiões do brasil)
description:
A vida fica melhor com sorvete

Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry's, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.

A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.

Sobre a Função

Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.

Responsabilidades

Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital. Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos; Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos. Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira. Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo. Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução. Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro. Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos. Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente. Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais. Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.

Qualificações

Ensino médio completo Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento. Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial. Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros). CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:

Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!

Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.

Oferecemos

Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível. Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas. Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.

Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.

Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades

A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Não toleramos qualquer forma de discriminação, inclusive com base em deficiência.

title: Gtm education & community manager
description:
We're hiring someone who walks into a room of founders and owns it by minute two.

R$14,700 to R$20,600 Monthly | Brazil, remote (Rio de Janeiro preferred) | Unlimited PTO

The role

You inherit a training program and a community that already work, and you are handed full ownership of both. From there it is yours: what gets taught and to whom, how the community runs, where the whole thing goes next. You teach live every week to founders betting their company on Microsoft Marketplace, and you own the number that says it landed. A real program to run and grow, not a blank page and not somebody else's to approve.

You'll join a marketing team of four (designer, growth marketer, content marketer), report to the Head of Marketing, and work daily with Customer Success, Account Managers, and Partnerships.

Who we're looking for

Someone who loves to teach and misses it when they stop. You can hold a room of CEOs, marketing and sales directors in English, and take a hard question without losing the thread. You come from B2 B sales, marketing, or startups, so the room recognizes you as one of them.

What you'll own

1. The program

The curriculum plan: what gets taught, in what order, to whom Live delivery, on camera, weekly Learning design: objectives, exercises, assessment, not slides The metric that proves it worked, and the rewrite when it didn't

2. The community

Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard Engaged participation as the number, not signups Members turned into content contributors Recurring interviews with our CEO, partners, and customers

What you bring

3-5 years teaching or running education programs. B2 B Saa S strongly preferred End-to-end ownership of a training program, not delivery only Live teaching to a business audience Community building: a peer network, user group, or alumni cohort Hands-on with GTM tooling, enough to teach while using it AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to review it. Raw AI output doesn't ship here

Nice to have

Microsoft partner, cloud marketplace, or co-sell motion GTM tools: Clay, Apollo, Lemlist Instructional design or adult learning LMS and community platforms: Circle, Teachable, Skilljar Portuguese, French, or Spanish fluency

Details

R$14,700 to R$20,600 per month, plus an end-of-year bonus Two recordings of trainings you have delivered in English, requested with your application Professional English (only English CVs will be considered)

About We Transact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

title: Technical sales engineer
description:
We are looking for a customer-focused Technical Sales Engineer to join Quortex.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales teams and customers to understand business challenges, design technical solutions, and demonstrate the value of Quortex technologies. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping customers evaluate architectural options and achieve their business objectives.

This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. You will work with telecommunications operators, broadcasters, media companies, streaming providers, and technology partners to design innovative video delivery and streaming solutions.

Professional proficiency in English is required. Portuguese and Spanish language skills are highly desirable to support customer engagement and business growth across the region.

What you'll do

Customer Engagement and Solution Consulting

Act as a technical advisor and subject matter expert for customers and partners. Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches. Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers. Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions. Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.

Solution Design and Technical Leadership

Design and present solution architectures across the Quortex portfolio, including Saa S, public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, and on-premises offerings. Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives. Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows. Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring. Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps. Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.

Pre-Sales Support

Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria. Participate in RFP and RFI processes. Prepare technical proposals and responses to customer requirements. Create solution documentation, architecture diagrams, and supporting technical materials. Troubleshoot technical issues related to Linux, networking, video systems, and system integrations during demonstrations and Proofs of Concept.

Business Development and Market Engagement

Contribute to territory planning and account strategies. Support lead-generation activities through customer engagement, webinars, presentations, events, and technical content. Collaborate with partners, resellers, systems integrators, and other ecosystem stakeholders to develop joint opportunities. Represent Quortex at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events when required. Participate as an exhibitor or speaker at relevant industry events, depending on experience and business needs.

Internal Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales teams. Provide customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to support product development. Help connect customer needs with product capabilities and future roadmap opportunities. Share technical knowledge and best practices across the organization.

What we're looking for

Mandatory Technical Experience

Knowledge of end-to-end video workflows, including:

Ingest

Encoding and transcoding

Statistical multiplexing, or statmux

Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, or ABR

Over-the-Top delivery, or OTT

Direct-to-Home distribution, or DTH

Primary distribution

Cable distribution

Experience troubleshooting Linux environments, networking, and system integrations. Knowledge of public and private cloud architectures applied to video workflows. Experience designing or deploying cloud-based video solutions. Ability to conduct Proofs of Concept, from understanding customer requirements to defining the proposed solution and success criteria. Ability to translate customer needs and technical feedback into product and roadmap recommendations. Experience participating in RFP or RFI processes and preparing technical proposals. Understanding of video processing, packaging, compression, content delivery, and streaming technologies. Experience with live and on-demand video architectures. Ability to design and explain technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable Technical Experience

Knowledge of advertising technologies and video monetization models. Experience with Server-Side Ad Insertion, or SSAI. Familiarity with Server-Guided Ad Insertion, or SGAI, and Dynamic Ad Insertion, or DAI. Experience with hybrid environments and the migration of video workflows to the cloud. Knowledge of broadcast and media standards, including:

SMPTE ST 2110

SCTE-35

SCTE-224

Experience with Content Delivery Networks. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes. Experience with video compression, packaging, encoding, DRM, and content delivery. Understanding of cloud-based media workflows and recording solutions. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.

Business and Customer Skills

Ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience discussing both technical requirements and business outcomes with customers. Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong organizational, prioritization, and project coordination skills. Commercial awareness and an understanding of Saa S business models. A customer-focused approach supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. Experience working with partners, resellers, systems integrators, or other ecosystem stakeholders is advantageous.

Differentiators

The following experience is not required but would be considered an advantage:

Participation in large-scale projects as a Solutions Architect or in a similar technical leadership role. Programming or scripting skills. Experience representing an organization at trade shows as an exhibitor, speaker, or technical presenter. Cloud architecture certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or another recognized provider. Additional training or certifications in video technologies, broadcast engineering, networking, or cloud architecture.

Preferred Background

We welcome candidates from a range of sectors, including:

Media and Entertainment Streaming Platforms Telecommunications Cloud and Saa S Companies Video Technology Vendors Systems Integration and Consulting

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work TM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

title: Product designer sênior
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay

Local de trabalho: Remoto

Modelo de trabalho: CLT

Objetivos do cargo

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Designer Sênior para atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de experiências digitais, conectando necessidades dos clientes, estratégia de produto e objetivos de negócio.

Esperamos alguém com domínio de UX e UI, capacidade de liderar problemas complexos, tomar decisões com autonomia e influenciar o produto por meio de design, pesquisa e dados.

Como esperamos que você atue aqui

Assuma a Direção: seja responsável pelas entregas do início ao fim, cumpra combinados e corrija a rota com senso de urgência. Vá Além: questione o "sempre foi assim", proponha melhorias com embasamento e clareza dos impactos. Foque no Cliente: tome decisões com empatia, mas com responsabilidade sobre o negócio, usando dados e racionalidade. Simplifique a Rota: transforme complexidade em clareza, desburocratizando processos e comunicando de forma objetiva. Atue Juntos: compartilhe contexto, construa pontes entre áreas, dê e receba feedbacks com respeito e maturidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderar problemas e projetos de design de ponta a ponta, desde a descoberta até a implementação e evolução da solução. Transformar necessidades dos clientes e objetivos de negócio em experiências simples, intuitivas e relevantes. Conduzir pesquisas, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e validações para apoiar decisões de design. Criar soluções de UX e UI, considerando interação, arquitetura da informação e qualidade visual. Trabalhar em parceria com Produto, Tecnologia, Dados e demais áreas na definição e evolução das soluções. Defender decisões de design com clareza, utilizando dados, pesquisa e argumentos de negócio. Identificar oportunidades, questionar premissas e propor melhorias para o produto e para o processo de design. Explorar e aplicar Inteligência Artificial no processo de design, utilizando-a para aumentar eficiência, acelerar exploração de soluções, apoiar pesquisas, análises, prototipação e documentação.

Requisitos e qualificações

É imprescindível que você tenha:

5+ anos de experiência como Product Designer ou em posições similares em produtos digitais. Domínio de UX, UI, Design Visual e Design de Interação. Experiência com pesquisa qualitativa, entrevistas e testes de usabilidade. Experiência trabalhando em ambientes multidisciplinares e próximos de Produto e Tecnologia. Autonomia, senso de ownership e capacidade de conduzir problemas complexos. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de apresentar e defender decisões de design. Proficiência em Figma. Familiaridade com Notion e Miro. Portfólio que demonstre processo, decisões e resultados, além das interfaces finais. Familiaridade com processos de Product Design utilizando Inteligência Artificial.

Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

Experiência com produtos de grande escala ou alta complexidade. Experiência com experimentação e uso de métricas para tomada de decisão. Experiência utilizando IA de forma prática para potencializar o processo de design. Interesse em compartilhar conhecimento e contribuir para o desenvolvimento do time. Perfil provocativo, curioso e orientado a criar experiências cada vez melhores para os clientes.

Informações adicionais

Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

Assistência Médica (Sul América) Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco) Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção: VA para compras em supermercados VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa) Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida Seguro de Vida Auxílio-Creche Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Data entry specialist
description: This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor. Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Office management manager-brazil(a114797)
description:
Position Overview

As a comprehensive workplace manager, you will be responsible for establishing the administrative system for large‐scale integrated workplaces, leading team management, and conducting in‐depth alignment with corporate headquarters administration.

Application Scope

This role applies to large‐scale integrated workplaces (headcount ≥ 50) or regional administrative lead positions. Incumbents are expected to undertake team management, budget decision‐making and strategic planning responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1.1 Workplace Operation Strategy & Management

1)Formulate regional workplace operation strategies, drive continuous improvement of office environment and employee experience upgrade.

2)Build regional 5 S management system and develop reusable management standards.

3)Plan annual activity calendar and oversee delivery of regional cultural events.

4)Establish reception service standards and coordinate cross‐regional high‐profile receptions.

5)Take overall charge of regional EHS compliance management and develop emergency response frameworks.

1.2 Expense & Budget Oversight

1)Lead preparation and review of regional administrative budgets, and take accountability for regional budget outcomes.

2)Approve regional expense disbursements, monitor compliance risks and identify cost‐saving & efficiency‐improvement opportunities.

3)Collaborate with headquarters to deliver regional cost optimization and maintain healthy overall expense performance.

4)Oversee payments to regional vendors, control payment schedules and leverage payment terms to optimize cash flow.

1.3 Asset Management Oversight

1)Establish regional asset management policy framework to guarantee consistency between asset records and physical inventory.

2)Approve major vehicle procurement and disposal proposals, and optimize allocation of regional vehicle resources.

3)Align with headquarters asset policies, and supervise regional asset inventory and disposal activities.

1.4 Vendor Management

1)Participate in headquarters‐level vendor framework negotiations to optimize regional supply chain.

2)Manage relationships with key regional vendors and drive continuous service improvement.

3)Develop regional vendor tier‐based management system to iteratively optimize supply‐chain structure.

4)Review and approve proposals for regional vendor onboarding and offboarding.

1.5 Regional Workplace Construction & Standardization

1)Develop strategies for launching new country‐level workplaces, align with headquarters resources to ensure standardized implementation.

2)Contribute to headquarters administrative standard formulation, and supervise regional training and compliance execution.

3)Facilitate experience sharing and methodology accumulation across regional workplaces.

1.6 Visa & Expat Assignment Support

1)Build regional support framework for expatriate employees, coordinate resources to guarantee smooth on‐landing for assignees.

2)Collaborate with headquarters Administration and HR teams to continuously enhance regional expatriate support solutions.

1.7 Onboarding & Offboarding Administrative Support

1)Establish standardized SOPs for regional employee onboarding and offboarding administrative support to deliver seamless employee experience and efficient handover.

1.8 Digital‐enabled Administrative Service

1)Lead promotion and operation of regional administrative service platforms to advance digitalization of local administrative services.

2)Consolidate regional system requirements and partner with headquarters Administration to iterate platform functionalities.

1.9 Communication & IT Infrastructure Support

1)Develop regional communication and IT infrastructure operation strategies to ensure stable connectivity of office networks and communication facilities.

2)Participate in formulation and optimization of regional IT support solutions.

1.10 Team Management

3)Directly manage administrative teams including Supervisors and Specialists, covering recruitment & selection, performance management and talent development.

4)Drive cross‐department collaboration within the region, represent the administrative function in business decision‐making and major project governance.

5)Maintain close alignment with headquarters Administration, and contribute to headquarters administrative decision‐making and system building.

6)Set up regional administrative talent pipeline development mechanisms.

Education & Professional Experience

Bachelor's degree or above, major in Administration Management, Business Administration, Human Resources or related disciplines is preferred. 5‐8 years or above working experience in administration, operation or relevant fields, with minimum 2 years of people‐management experience. Prior experience in multinational enterprises or cross‐cultural management is a plus.

Core Competencies

Strategic Thinking: Systematic mindset, capable of contributing to headquarters standard‐setting and providing professional judgment for regional matters. Business Acumen: Take ownership of regional administrative budget performance; proactively identify cost‐reduction and efficiency‐gain opportunities. Organizational Influence: Direct‐line team management capability, with proven track record in talent selection, development and performance management. Cross‐cultural Communication: Deliver effective communication across cultures and hierarchy levels, and manage complex stakeholder relationships. Risk Anticipation: Foresee potential risks, formulate contingency plans and resolve regional issues in a systematic manner.

Language & Qualifications

Fluent in English and local language for high‐level business communication and negotiation. Possess a valid local driving license.

Next steps:

title: Accounting lead
description:
Position Purpose

To lead and oversee the Accounting, Fiscal (Tax), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury functions. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational and reporting excellence across all financial processes. This leader must act as a strategic business consultant, ensuring strategic alignment and supporting decision-making across the entire company.

The owner of the role is also responsible for the fulfillment of both the Grünenthal and local Codes of Conduct in the activities organized by him/her, as well as in those in which he/she participates.

Key Responsibilities

Fiscal, Tax Governance, and Credits

Lead the tax credit strategy, actively seeking efficient and additional tax optimization opportunities, in full compliance and alignment with corporate governance. Lead the entire implementation and update of the Brazilian Tax Reform, analyzing its impacts and ensuring business continuity and compliance. Manage the relationship and deliverables of external consultants (Tax). Lead compliance processes with external audit firms (Big Four). Ensure full operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures. Search for efficient tax strategies, according to corporate guidance.

Accounting, Audit, and Treasury Management

Oversee all Accounting (IFRS/CPCs/German GAAP), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury routines. Lead and coordinate all external (Big Four) and internal audit processes, ensuring deadlines are met and recommendations are correctly implemented. Ensure the accuracy and correct recording of all financial transactions. Lead initiatives to optimize working capital. Lead Continuous Process Improvement initiatives. Manage the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and execution of activities performed by the Shared Service Center (SSC) in Lisbon, Portugal. Coordinate accounting, tax, and treasury projects and ensure their implementation according to corporate requirements. Identify and establish effective procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure proper reporting to governmental entities in accordance with local legislation. Manage the Other Operating Results Budget. Prepare and monitor Cash Flow. Ensure operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.

Capability Requirements

Mandatory

University Degree in Accounting. Active CRC (CPA equivalent). Solid experience in Accounting and Tax Management. Experience working with a Shared Service Center (SSC). Experience reviewing Financial Statements. Experience reviewing ECD and ECF filings.

Desirable

MBA or Postgraduate Degree in Finance or Controlling. Previous experience with auditing firms (Big Four).

Interfaces

Internal

All business areas, with particular interaction with: Sales Marketing Supply Chain Legal Finance Teams

External

Big Four Auditors Tax and Accounting Consultants Banks Tax Authorities (RFB and others) Fiscal and Accounting BPO Providers

title: Regional finance manager, latin america
description:
Heidrick & Struggles is the world's foremost advisor on executive leadership, driving superior client performance through premier human capital leadership advisory services. For more than 70 years, we've delivered value for our clients by leveraging unrivaled expertise to help organizations discover and enable outstanding leaders and teams. Learn more at

Job Description:

Who we Are

Heidrick & Struggles is a premier provider of global leadership advisory and on-demand talent solutions, serving the senior-level talent and consulting needs of the world's top organizations. In our role as trusted leadership advisors, we partner with our clients to develop future-ready leaders and organizations, bringing together our services and offerings in executive search, diversity and inclusion, leadership assessment and development, organization and team acceleration, culture shaping and on-demand, independent talent solutions. Heidrick & Struggles pioneered the profession of executive search more than 70 years ago. Today, the firm provides integrated talent and human capital solutions to help our clients change the world, one leadership team at a time.®

Additional information on the firm can be found at

The Role

The Regional Finance Manager - Latin America (RFD) oversees the financial activities for the Latin America region, encompassing five offices across three countries which generate revenue more than USD 20 M. The position reports directly to the Global Finance Director for Executive Search (GFD) and partners closely with the Latin America Regional Leader (RL) and the region's operational management team. This role plays an integral part in the company's strategic direction, development, and future growth in the region and serves as the primary finance liaison to field operational teams.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop the Latin America Finance teams, ensuring high performance, engagement, and robust succession planning. Oversee Latin America financial assurance, the control environment, operational analysis, and recurring financial and business processes with an investment and value-creation orientation. Develop an intimate understanding of the regional business, its key drivers, and market dynamics, maintaining strong working relationships at all levels of operations. Drive annual planning and forecasting processes to deliver office and practice budgets, as well as strategic plans that enhance regional success, growth, and profitability, in collaboration with corporate and operational teams. Manage monthly and quarterly detailed financial reviews and management reporting packages to measure historical and current performance, providing clear insight and recommendations. Generate and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency and profitability across the region. Create analyses and financial models to support regional growth initiatives, new investments, strategic and operational efforts, and to enable improved financial decision-making and sustainable performance improvement. Use management information and KPIs to provide insight into trends that support the effective running of the region and drive continuous improvement. Prepare presentations and supporting financial analysis and materials for leadership team meetings and regional reviews, as required. Approve and manage regional expenditure budgets, ensuring disciplined cost management and alignment with strategic priorities. Review and approve commercial Terms & Conditions for new business assignments, including margin expectations and risk considerations. Own externally facing finance and operational components across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, including vendor relationships, leases, facilities obligations, landlord negotiations, benefits vendors, and other locally administered commercial matters, ensuring appropriate oversight, cost control, approval discipline, and escalation visibility. Collaborate closely with regional finance leaders and accounting teams in other geographies to ensure alignment of financial strategies, policies, and operational goals. Oversee locally administered payroll, consultant compensation, bonus accruals, statutory accounting, tax provisions, cash and intercompany activity, and related accounting entries, partnering with local tax, accounting, banking, legal, and labor compliance advisors to ensure alignment with US GAAP, statutory requirements, corporate policy, and local regulations.

Required Qualifications:

Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, with a strong record of academic achievement. Minimum of five (5) years of corporate finance experience, demonstrating increasing levels of responsibility and scope. Proven track record operating as a trusted finance business partner to senior leadership. Intelligent and highly creative individual, at ease interacting with executive decision makers and discussing the pros and cons of project alternatives as a respectful, equal participant. Strong sense of how businesses operate in a global context and the ability to bring a macro perspective to business opportunities and regional decisions. Demonstrated project management expertise, including leading complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion. Fluency in English and at least one major Latin American language (Portuguese and/or Spanish). Recognizes trends and events outside the organization and focuses the organization's financial, operational and human capital on the issues that affect performance. Superior analytical skills balanced by a keen ability to integrate the larger strategic picture, rapidly understand and explain complex issues in simple terms, and develop a range of potential solutions. Develops and applies creative solutions to business problems, anticipates situations and needs, finds flexible answers to new situations, and champions innovation to improve business performance. Forms networks of positive business relationships that enhance personal and business success. Partners with colleagues across all departments, service lines, and other regions as one team to ensure a successful outcome for the firm. A well-balanced individual defined not only as smart, but pragmatic. An outstanding communicator with excellent negotiation skills who will be viewed as a team player, with the ability to build a network of support from people at both corporate and business unit levels. Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects with an ability to drive successful outcomes with a shared commitment among a diverse team. Ability to work with the senior leadership of the Company as a peer, and to be perceived as a valuable business partner. A self-starter who is one step ahead while ensuring that others on the team are not left behind. Able to position and coach others to achieve industry-leading standards. Strong work ethic and unquestionable integrity.

Preferred Qualifications:

Chartered Accountant qualification; part-qualified accountants will be considered. Strong understanding of Latin America taxation and regulatory frameworks. Professional services sector experience; direct industry experience in executive search is not required. Additional language skills beyond English and Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Heidrick & Struggles is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, veteran or military status, or citizenship status.

title: Analista fiscal sênior (impostos diretos e indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company's tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary. Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others. Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation. Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information. Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements. Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications. Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST. Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team. Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information. Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies. Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients. Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency. Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis. Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements. Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company. Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field. Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes. Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF. Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST. Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices. Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred. Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations. Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

Position offered shall be determined by the candidate's years of relevant experience and skillsets. All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.
